description: There is nothing wrong with have a preference. I like what I like #selflove #flexibility #selfcare
transcript: And everything that I do, I lead with my preferences. I have a refined palate. I know what I like to eat. I know what I like to drink. I know the people, places and things that I enjoy. And I don't need a lot of options because I like what I like. I don't allow the world to make me feel guilty for choosing one thing over the other. We don't need unlimited options. We know what we like.
